_comment: Provisional heuristic weights and thresholds for the HighWater Risk & Prioritization Engine (Module 3). All values are editable without modifying source code. These are DECISION-SUPPORT HEURISTICS, not validated flood-risk predictions.

scoring._comment_formula: raw_score = (w_flood_pct * flood_component) + (w_exposure * exposure_component) + (w_isolation * isolation_component) + (w_flood_area * flood_area_component) + (w_exp_frac * exposure_fraction_component). Each component is independently normalised to [0,1]. raw_score in [0,1] is then scaled to [0,100].

normalization._comment: Values used to normalize each component to [0,1]. Exceeding the cap is clamped to 1.0.

isolation_score._comment: Additive isolation penalty per accessibility category.

priority_thresholds._comment: Score boundaries (inclusive lower bound). score >= CRITICAL_THRESHOLD -> CRITICAL, etc.

data_quality._comment: Flags that trigger a data-quality warning instead of silent zero-risk assignment.
